## About
River Road Auto Service is a neighborhood repair shop on River Road in Bethesda. We handle regularly scheduled maintenance, brake work, oil changes and state inspections, and we look at whatever else is bothering your car.
Our customers tell it better than we can. One reviewer said our service manager is candid up front, including about likely costs. Another said they rely on us to keep their older cars running. A third simply stopped in for air in a tire and had every tire checked.
When you need fuel instead of a fix, our gas pumps stay open on weekends too, even when the shop is closed.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Keep your car running the way it should with regular maintenance at fair prices.
- Brake services: If something feels wrong when you stop, bring the car in and we will look it over.
- State inspections: A thorough checkup to make sure your car is safe for you and others on the road.
- Tire help: From a slow leak to a quick top off of air, one reviewer called our tire service prompt.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do state inspections?
A: Yes. Bring your vehicle in for a thorough inspection checkup.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: The shop is open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: When are the gas pumps open?
A: The gas pumps are open 7 days a week from 6:00 am to 11:00 pm.

Q: How do I request service?
A: You can request service online or call us directly at 301-986-1221.
